authorship: AI-authored on 2026-11-17 and fixed before running the strategy comparison on this batch; not independently annotated or reviewed by the user.
labels: No gold labels. Scenario tags are coverage intentions only, never model inputs. This is a fresh exploratory batch, not an independently labelled test set.
instructions: Which team should handle this request? If the request does not provide enough information to choose a team, select needs_clarification.

criteria.billing: Payments, duplicate charges, invoices and refunds
criteria.technical: Software errors, API failures and account access problems
criteria.delivery: Missing parcels, damaged parcels and delivery tracking
criteria.needs_clarification: Insufficient information to identify the relevant team

cases.state: The receipt lists the wrong company name and tax number. Please issue a corrected invoice.
My annual renewal was advertised at 80 dollars, but the renewal payment was 120 dollars.
The payment page said the transaction was declined, yet there is a pending charge on my bank statement.
After signing in, the web dashboard stays blank in both browsers. Clearing the cache did not help.
File uploads always stop at 67 percent and display an unexpected error.
The account rejects every two-factor authentication code although my phone clock is correct.
The courier took my parcel to a different building. The delivery photo is not my doorway.
There has been no tracking update for two weeks and the expected arrival date has passed.
Only one of the three boxes in this shipment arrived. Where are the other two boxes?
Can you update my details? They are no longer correct.
I cannot complete this order and do not know what is wrong.
My parcel was damaged in transit and my card shows two charges. Please address both problems.
